items.title: 67246_Buck Clayton oral history interview
items.q: Because John took me there to hear the band.

ctx.x: : What I'm curious about though is how they managed to pay any money in a little box like that.
Well, they paid more than we got at the Savoy and that's a big place and we made thirty-three dollars a week. I guess more rich people come down in there.
: Yes. That's where the band really started to click?
